The Higgs boson is an excitation of the: The Higgs boson is an excitation of the Higgs field. Interaction with this field contributes to the mass of elementary particles that couple to it.
The Higgs field helps explain the origin: The Higgs field helps explain the origin of the mass of elementary particles such as the electron. It is not an object hidden inside them.

The gold dotted lines symbolize attracti: The gold dotted lines symbolize attractions between molecules. Hydrogen bonds play a major role in water.
The gold lines symbolize the nuclear int: The gold lines symbolize the nuclear interaction that binds nearby nucleons. It is related to the strong interaction between their quarks.
